about: GAP-FIX-R4 (Appendix J Part 3 Stage 4, F.3, Law 2): the social-layer tone gate's scope, lexicon and reviewed exceptions. The same engine as the D.8 Family Hub gate (agent/tools/check-family-copy-tone.mjs) reads this file through agent/tools/check-social-copy-tone.mjs. It covers the profile and social copy: every group of rebuild-profile.json, the OD-27 (1) goals-together copy, and the Family connection panels. docs/operations/SOCIAL-COPY-TONE-GATE.md explains how to change it. An exception needs a reason a reviewer can check.

scope.surfacesWhy: The profile, people-list, connection, report and account screens (rebuild/social, rebuild/account and their routes), and /learn/together (OD-27 (1)). A person reads only these surfaces' own copy; the gate fails if one of them starts rendering a raw Core message.
scope.subtreesWhy: Every group of rebuild-profile.json is in scope (scope.complete: a new group fails until it is listed), plus rebuild-learn.json `together` and the learner-home card's three together keys and the Family connection groups of rebuild-family.json, which the D.8 gate also reads under its own lexicon. A social surface that names a rebuild-profile or rebuild-family group outside this list fails (scope.coverage), so a later lane cannot add social copy the gate never reads.

guarantee.why: D.7 and Block E: no social copy may promise a safety, privacy or protection outcome the system does not enforce (a report is read by people; a private profile is a setting, not a guarantee).

messaging.why: E.10: there is no messaging between accounts. Social copy may not offer, imply or name a chat, a message, an inbox or a reply.

glossary.why: Owner log §5, the controlled glossary: the verified parent is the Tutor, never a guardian or a legal representative; the AI is the Mentor, never a bot, an assistant or an AI tutor; coins, never money.

bank_register.why: Law 2: social copy never slips into a bank's voice (a transaction, funds, fees, a balance, a declined request).

legal_register.why: Law 2 and Block E: a report, a removal or a deletion is explained plainly, never in a legal or disciplinary register.

shouting.why: Law 2: a mentor never shouts: no stacked exclamation marks, no words in capitals, no raw error codes.

exceptions.why: The H.1 analytics disclosure lists what the events never contain (message text, voice, passwords); it names data that is excluded and offers no messaging.
The H.1 disclosure says moderation safety records stay on whatever the analytics choice; it states why an enforced retention exists (the safety records are kept regardless), not an outcome.
A teen said no to a connection request (E.8), a decision about a person, not a money transaction; the same reading as the reviewed family exception for socialRequests.deny.
Confirms a Tutor refused a friend request for their child, a decision about a person, not a money transaction (the same exception the D.8 gate holds).
Tells a 16-17 teen that nobody can message them even when discoverable, which E.10 enforces: there is no messaging surface at all.
The OD-27 (1) goals-together rule says there is no chat; E.10 enforces it (no free text on a goal, strict Core bodies).
The Tutor opt-in card says goals together have no chat; E.10 enforces it (no free text on a goal, strict Core bodies).
In es-MX and pt-BR "reporte de seguridad" / "denuncia de segurança" names the safety report under review; it describes an event and promises nothing.
The es-MX/pt-BR section label "Seguridad" / "Segurança" heads the report and block controls on a profile; it names a set of controls and promises nothing.
The report note names who reads it, "our safety team" ("equipo de seguridad" / "equipe de segurança"); it names people and promises nothing.
Confirms a report from inside a goal reached the safety team ("equipo de seguridad" / "equipe de segurança"); it names who reads it and promises nothing.
The es-MX/pt-BR heading of the child safety notices list; it names a list of moderation notices and promises nothing (the same exception the D.8 gate holds).
The empty state of the child safety notices list; it names a list and promises nothing (the same exception the D.8 gate holds).
Confirms a Tutor report reached the safety team ("equipo de seguridad" / "equipe de segurança"); it names who reads the report and promises nothing.
